title: Ux designer pleno
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ux designer pleno em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/Product Designer Pleno II para atuar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a construção e evolução de produtos digitais que geram impacto em escala. Buscamos uma pessoa com forte visão de produto, autonomia, pensamento analítico e capacidade de transformar desafios complexos em experiências intuitivas, eficientes e orientadas a resultados.           Responsabilidade e atribuições:  Conduzir o processo de Design end-to-end, desde a descoberta do problema até a validação da solução.  Realizar pesquisas com usuários, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento.  Criar fluxos, wireframes, protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade.  Facilitar workshops de discovery, ideação e cocriação.  Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplas squads e iniciativas de negócio.  Utilizar dados, métricas e insights para embasar decisões de produto e experiência.  Trabalhar em parceria com Product Managers, Tech Leads, Desenvolvedores e demais stakeholders.  Garantir consistência, qualidade e evolução contínua das experiências digitais.  Apoiar a implementação das soluções junto aos times de desenvolvimento.           Requisitos e qualificações:   Experiência em UX Design, Product Design ou áreas correlatas.  Vivência com Design Thinking, Arquitetura da Informação e Design de Interação.  Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade.  Domínio de ferramentas de prototipação e design de interfaces.  Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na definição de métodos, entregáveis e priorização de atividades.  Conhecimento em ambientes ágeis e trabalho com times multidisciplinares.  Excelente comunicação, organização e storytelling.  Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Espanhol fluente como terceira lingua  Experiência em produtos digitais complexos e ambientes enterprise.  Conhecimento em Design Systems.  Vivência em indústria, operações, automação ou tecnologia.  Experiência atuando em múltiplas squads simultaneamente.  Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao processo de Design. O que esperamos de você Perfil protagonista e orientado a resultados.  Mentalidade baseada em dados e evidências.  Facilidade para navegar em contextos complexos e multidisciplinares.  Curiosidade, senso crítico e aprendizado contínuo.  Capacidade de influenciar decisões através de uma visão estratégica de produto e experiência.           Informações adicionais:  Modelo de contratação: Cooperativa   Benefícios que oferecemos:  Plano de saúdePlano odontológicoWellhubDescanso remuneradoDay off no mês do aniversárioVale RefeiçãoModelo de contratação cooperativo  mais autonomia e parceria no dia a dia

Atuando de forma consultiva na compreensão dos desafios assistenciais, operacionais e financeiros dos clientes, conectando diferentes soluções, parceiros e recursos do ecossistema de saúde e tecnologia para construção de projetos personalizados e de alto valor agregado.  Escopo de Atuação Conduzir e orientar ciclos de negociações com parceiros estratégicos em grandes organizações, considerando sempre as diretrizes e estratégia da companhia e os alinhamentos internos com a operação, além de assegurar a aplicação de desenhos e modelos vantajosos para os stakeholders envolvidos. Executar e acompanhar o plano de negócios previamente definido, visando o alcance das metas de receita. Conduzir e orientar o ciclo de vendas consultivas e a qualificação de novas oportunidades no segmento enterprise (grandes empresas independente do segmento) e parcerias, mantendo acompanhamento rigoroso do pipeline. Conduzir e orientar reuniões consultivas de forma a entender em profundidade os desafios estratégicos, assistenciais e financeiros dos clientes, traçando diagnósticos assertivos para elaborar propostas comerciais com soluções e produtos sob medida, atuando como consultor de negócios e estruturando soluções que integrem diferentes players do mercado de saúde e tecnologia, conforme as necessidades específicas de cada cliente com base no portfólio HealthBit, parcerias disponíveis e em conjunto com equipes técnicas, representando a proposta de valor HBit, enquanto uma consultoria estratégica, com alto nível de personalização e qualidade. Garantir a manutenção das parcerias  e vendas estabelecidas, através do monitoramento dos indicadores de sucesso, da correção de conduta e direcionamento para caminhos mais adequados, além do relacionamento com os parceiros e times internos, atuando como ponto focal do negócio, visando sempre a produtividade e sustentabilidade da parceria. Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios, assim como oportunidades de expansão e novos projetos na carteira de clientes existente, atuando de forma consultiva para compreender necessidades, conectar soluções e fortalecer relacionamentos com decisores e influenciadores, gerando valor para os clientes e para a HealthBit.   Conduzir e orientar alinhamentos com times internos da operação e do parceiro para o desenho, implantação e manutenção dos projetos em parceria, além de acompanhar as entregas realizadas em cada projeto, verificando a satisfação dos clientes. Realizar alinhamentos e manter relacionamento próximo ao time de Marketing para planejamento e execução de ações para atração de novos clientes. Atuar como referência nas atividades relacionadas a parcerias e vendas, prestando suporte técnico às áreas envolvidas e operação, visando garantir o alcance das metas previamente estabelecidas. Fornecer, de forma adequada, informações sobre temas de interesse estratégico que possibilitem a tomada de decisão, além de organizar e desdobrar atividades da área, colaborando com o desenvolvimento da organização no contexto das mudanças. Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao  cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência.  Requisitos:Experiência no ecossistema de saúde, com vivência em saúde suplementar, saúde corporativa, operadoras, hospitais, healthtechs ou segmentos relacionados. Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva, identificando desafios dos clientes e estruturando soluções que gerem valor assistencial, operacional e financeiro. Experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios, gestão de relacionamentos e negociações complexas em ambientes B2B, envolvendo múltiplos decisores e ciclos de venda consultiva. Domínio de técnicas de vendas consultivas. Excel avançado  Diferencial  Vivência na estruturação e implementação de soluções, projetos ou modelos de atendimento customizados para clientes corporativos. Experiência em ambientes de saúde, tecnologia, inovação ou consultoria, com atuação integrada entre diferentes players do ecossistema de saúde. Conhecimento do mercado de saúde suplementar e dos principais atores da cadeia de saúde e tecnologia. Networking ativo e relacionamento consolidado com executivos e influenciadores do mercado de Saúde Corporativo e Recursos Humanos.  Perfil Comportamental   Comunicação assertiva; Capacidade de influência e argumentação; Visão Estratégica de negócio e capacidade analítica; Colaboração; Proatividade; Planejamento e Organização; Relacionamento Interpessoal; Resiliência. Este profissional será uma referência na área, responsável por identificar oportunidades de investimento, gerar insumos comerciais, construir e disseminar as melhores práticas e monitorar indicadores para assegurar o alinhamento com metas e orçamentos. Estamos buscando candidatos proativos, com espírito empreendedor e que desejam construir uma carreira de sucesso nas seguintes áreas:  Crédito: Ajude nossos clientes a realizarem seus sonhos com soluções como consórcios, financiamentos e home equity  Empresas: Ajude nossos clientes a encontrar as melhores soluções para suas empresas, criando um relacionamento de confiança e parceria, além de um apoio especializado em operações de câmbio. Renda Variável: Apoie nossos clientes nas decisões de investimento em Renda Variável, levando em conta o cenário de mercado, as análises da equipe de research e o perfil específico de cada investidor.  Internacional: Apoie nossos clientes em investimentos no exterior, acompanhando o mercado global e oferecendo soluções internacionais.  O que valorizamos em você:   Paixão pela área financeira: Experiência é bem-vinda, mas o seu forte interesse em uma de nossas áreas de atuação é essencial.  Cultura centrada no cliente: Valorizamos profissionais que coloquem as necessidades dos clientes em primeiro lugar em todas as decisões.  Perfil consultivo e relacional: Buscamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que gostem de construir relacionamentos sólidos e de confiança com os clientes.  Proatividade e sede de aprendizado: Se você tem atitude proativa, é comunicativo e está sempre em busca de novos conhecimentos e desafios, você tem o perfil que procuramos.  Visão de longo prazo: Procuramos candidatos que queiram crescer conosco no mercado financeiro.  Formação e certificações: Formação superior é desejável, e certificações financeiras são um diferencial que valorizamos.    O que a Alto Valor Investimentos oferece:   Um ambiente de trabalho meritocrático, onde seu desempenho é reconhecido e recompensado.  Compromisso com a ética e a transparência em todas as nossas operações.  Suporte contínuo para o seu desenvolvimento profissional.  Programas de treinamento e capacitação para aprimorar suas habilidades.  A oportunidade de construir uma carreira sólida em um mercado em constante crescimento.  A chance de impactar positivamente a vida financeira de nossos clientes.  Remuneração compatível com o mercado.    Não perca essa oportunidade de fazer parte do nosso futuro!  Cadastre seu currículo em nosso Banco de Talentos e seja o primeiro a ser considerado para futuras vagas na Alto Valor Investimentos.

Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information.   Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.   Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system.   You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.     What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. description:

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!   Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.    Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.    Atividades:   Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.    Responsabilidades e atribuições:   • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;  • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;  • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;  • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;  • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;  • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;  • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.    Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;  • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;  • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;  • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;  • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;  • Domínio do Pacote Office;  • CNH categoria B;  • Disponibilidade para viagens;  • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;    Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;  • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;  • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;  • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

description:
Nova vaga disponível para Coordenador de Armazém - Page Interim em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Experiência prévia com gestão de armazém para volumes secos.   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    Sobre nosso cliente   Empresa nacional do setor de embalagens busca, através de Page Interim, Coordenador de Depósito para liderar a gestão de armazéns de embalagens e caixas metálicas, em que será responsável pela programação de expedições e coletas, gestão de volumes, tratativa de desvios de qualidade e reporte de indicadores de desempenho para a matriz global.   Descrição   Liderar e gerenciar todas as operações do depósito/armazém, garantindo que as metas de produção sejam atingidas de forma regular, segura e eficiente.   Garantir a execução precisa e pontual de todas as transações do sistema (SAP, GEMS, RFID/digitalização), incluindo o fechamento do mês e as atualizações de estoque.   Gerenciar os níveis de estoque para garantir um tempo de resposta rápido, reduzindo o estoque ocioso e mantendo o trabalho em andamento (WIP) dentro das metas definidas (por exemplo, não mais do que 7 dias).   Monitorar, analisar e reduzir danos e rejeições por parte de destinatários e embaladores, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas para resolver as causas-raiz.   Supervisionar os fluxos de entrada e saída para garantir um tráfego fluido, carga/descarga eficiente e uso otimizado da capacidade do depósito.   Gerenciar e melhorar continuamente os processos de controle de qualidade e inspeção para manter os padrões de qualidade e reduzir reclamações de clientes.   Preparar e conduzir CARs eficazes para reclamações de clientes e não conformidades internas, garantindo um acompanhamento robusto e o encerramento dos casos.   Estabelecer, manter e fazer cumprir os SOPs, fluxos de processo e padrões de inspeção no depósito, alinhados com os procedimentos globais.   Exercer uma liderança firme e assertiva junto às equipes dos depósitos e prestadores de serviços, responsabilizando-os pelo desempenho, conformidade e segurança.   Conduzir negociações e avaliações de desempenho com os prestadores de serviços de depósito e logística, garantindo melhores níveis de serviço, eficiência de custos e confiabilidade.   Identificar e resolver questões operacionais complexas, utilizando análise de dados e colaboração multifuncional para implementar soluções sustentáveis e criativas.   Impulsionar o controle, a redução e a contenção de custos nas operações do depósito, aplicando uma visão de custo total de propriedade a todas as despesas.   Oferecer um alto padrão de atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas, garantindo uma comunicação clara, proativa e orientada para soluções.   Gerenciar a comunicação operacional diária (por exemplo, e-mails, relatórios, painéis) para manter as partes interessadas informadas sobre desempenho, riscos e planos de ação.   Apoiar o Gerente de Cadeia de Suprimentos e a equipe local conforme necessário, atuando como ponto de contato principal para assuntos e iniciativas relacionados ao depósito.    Perfil desejável   Graduação em qualquer área de Engenharia, Logística, Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão de Armazéns ou áreas correlatas;   Experiência em gestão de armazéns;   Conhecimentos de informática - Microsoft Office, Outlook, etc;   Conhecimento em SAP;   Conhecimento em ISO 45001 e WMS;   Experiência com Lean / Six Sigma será diferencial;   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    O que está sendo ofertado   Faixa salarial de R$8.000,00 a R$10.000,00;   Contrato terceiro (CLT) através de Page Interim;   Modelo de Trabalho: modelo híbrido 3x2 (Campinas/SP).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

How familiar are you with coding best practices?  Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role. We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages. Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.    Are you located in Argentina?  Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position.    What Would Be a Plus?    Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI?  Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges.    Are you well-versed in system security principles?  A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.    Are you available to work on call when needed?  Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.  DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.  Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together!  We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile:   Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;   Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);   Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;   Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Client services assistant
description:
Empresa está contratando Client services assistant em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Client Services Assistant   Remote, Latin America   Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.   We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.   This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.   You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.   If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.   What You'll Own -----------   Client Services Operations   This is the center of the role.   You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.   You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.   The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.   Pipeline + Relationship Tracking   You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.   You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.   Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination   You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.   That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.   You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.   This Role Is a Fit If You:   • Notice gaps and communicate them early   • Take ownership without needing to be chased   • Track details carefully and follow through completely   • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer   • Can support a busy team without adding noise   • Stay calm when priorities shift   • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful   This Role Is Not a Fit If You:   • Need detailed instructions for every task   • Wait to be told what to do next   • See problems but don't speak up   • Think "done" means "mostly handled"   • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented   Requirements   • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills   • Clear written and verbal English   • High ownership and follow-through   • Strong attention to detail   • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities   • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems   • Fast, stable internet connection   • Professional presence on video   Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.   Work Setup   Remote, Latin America preferred   Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours   Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)   How to Apply   We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.   You'll submit:   • Your resume   • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you   • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work   We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.   We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.   If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

description:

Company Description:   Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.   Role Overview:   As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.   Offer Details:   Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) Skills:   Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Key Qualifications:   Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:   In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:   BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details:   Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Direct-response ad video editor em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.   You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.   Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.   This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.   What You'll Be Doing   Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need   Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required)   Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need   A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.   Compensation   Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.   How To Apply   There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:   Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.   To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.   Propósito do Cargo   Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.   Responsabilidades Principais:   Desenvolvimento Backend   Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura   Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações   Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy   Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento   Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios:   Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis:   Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos:   Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura:   Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix   Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.   Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.   Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

description:
Nova vaga disponível para Especialista de consolidação/consolidation specialist - oportunidade também para pcd♿ em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.    The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.      KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.      Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.      One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.      OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.      REQUIREMENTS:    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).    Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.    Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).      Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).    Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.    Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.      In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Desenvolvedor de software pleno - ia
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Desenvolvedor de software pleno - ia em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA: Estamos em busca de profissionais para desenvolver e sustentar funcionalidades de software e também de sua interface, que agreguem valor ao produto, garantindo a satisfação do cliente dentro do segmento de atuação. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias front-end e back-end envolvidas no projeto; Conhecer a arquitetura front-end e back-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades; Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes; Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação; Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento; Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados; Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio; Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Formação: Superior completo em tecnologia e afins Conhecimentos técnicos: Linguagem de programação para back-end (Node.js e Type Script) – nível avançado; Linguagem de programação para front-end (React) – nível avançado; Fundamentos em frameworks de back-end (exemplo: Nest JS, Spring, Express, Rails, outros) – nível avançado; Fundamento em testes unitários - nível avançado; Banco de Dados (Relacional e No Sql)– nível avançado; Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software – desejável nível intermediário; Arquitetura de Software (exemplo: cliente-servidor, web, outros) Experiência com segurança de aplicações e autenticação (OAuth2, JWT). Mentorar desenvolvedores Júnior e Pleno, além de influenciar decisões de negócio através da tecnologia; Vivência em projetos com filas Conhecimento em Serverless Conhecimento em AWS Vivência com uso de IA para geração de códigos Requisitos desejáveis: Experiência com projetos usando (Spec-Driven Development) - (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Especificação) Conhecimento em CI/CD; Certificações AWS. INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador; ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais; ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores; ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito; ● Plano de saúde e odontológico; ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação; ● Vale transporte; ● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida; ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário; ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida; ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada; ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar; ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #seja TOTVS

Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Nova vaga disponível para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager  Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.  This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.  What you’ll do: • Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online • Analyze performance and double down on what works Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.) Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips  2. Podcast Clip Strategy Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan  Decide what clips get posted, when, and where  Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)  3. Growth & Optimization Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase: Views Engagement Follower growth A/B test captions, formats, and posting times  4. Platform Expertise Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)  5. Systems & Organization Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system  Track posted content and performance metrics Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting  6. Collaboration Work closely with: Editors (to refine clips) Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals) Leadership (to align on growth strategy)  What we’re looking for: • Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video) • Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts • Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior • Ability to manage both content output + community interaction  Must-Haves 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content) Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video  Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts Strong instincts for what makes content go viral  Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day) Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.   Nice-to-Haves Experience working with podcasts or long-form content Background in content editing or scripting Familiarity with tools like: Asana/ Slack Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.) Analytics tools Experience managing multiple brands or clients  Bonus: • Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands • Background in content editing or scripting • Experience building or managing online communities This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Empresa está contratando Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Company Description SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation. Role Description This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency. Qualifications Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies Experience in technical analysis and process optimization Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Summary  We are a family-owned business group  overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production . Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant  to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments. Responsibilities  Manage and optimize executive calendars  across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements  including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed Conduct research  on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems  across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Handle personal administrative tasks  as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance  Qualifications  2–5 years of experience  as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders Exceptional written and verbal communication skills  in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities  Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality  and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup  Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours   Preferred Qualifications  Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives  across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping  Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions  Comfort working in both clinical / professional  and creative / entertainment  environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier  What We Offer  Competitive compensation commensurate with experience  Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership  across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours  Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Risk Management Officer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities:  Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including; Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring; Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.  Requirements:  Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper  standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent; unblemished reputation; knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities; technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ruby on Rails Developer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)  We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States. THE ROLE  Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent. You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR  5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments) Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity  BONUS POINTS  Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations) Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines  WHAT YOU'LL DO  Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations) Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams  YOUR IMPACT  Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department
