title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Professor de francês em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
Empresa está contratando Technology Manager (Licensed Entities) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives. You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing  Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil  What you'll need  5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English  Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Arquiteto Java
description:

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Development Orchestrator em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Location:  Remote Type:  Full-Time Reports to:  CEO Stack:  TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:  Immediate The Company  Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role  You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do  Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.  Must-Haves  Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.  Strong Signals  Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.  Red Flags  AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.  Who This Person Is  3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate  No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.  What We Offer  A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.  To Apply or Refer  Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra,  comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria  de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.   Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.  Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES  Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo ; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.  Competências Comportamentais:  Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.  Required Skills & Experience • 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.  • Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.  • Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.  • Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.  • Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability. Nice to Have Skills & Experience • CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.  • Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).  • AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).  • Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).  • Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks. Job Description The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.  • Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.  • Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.  • Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”  • Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.  • Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.  • Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.  • Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.  • Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.  • Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.  • Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment. Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations. Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions. Responsibilities   User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve  Required Experience  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc Experience working with AWS Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools   Preferred Experience  Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence Familiarity with the yard management industry Awareness of logistics and supply chain management  Additional Information  Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP   About Velozient  We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.
